$comment: The shape of one plugin's declaration, plugins/<stem>/<stem>.decl.json. tools/omx-new-plugin.mjs asks its questions from the titles and descriptions here; tools/plugin-recipe.mjs validates every declaration against it.

stem.title: Stem
stem.description: The plugin's file name: omx-<short>, its directory under plugins/, its .clap and its .lv2 bundle. Unique.

kernel.title: Kernel
kernel.description: The plugin's C name, which names its generated header and its faces (omx_<kernel>_params.h, omx_<kernel>_clap.c). For a plugin over one omx-dsp kernel it is that kernel's omx-contract name.

kernels.title: Kernels
kernels.description: The omx-contract kernels the parameters reference (data/kernels/<kernel>.json). One entry is the normal case; several make a composite, and then each parameter names its kernel. A kernel omx-contract does not have yet is NEW: the kernel recipe in omx-contract and omx-dsp runs first. Defaults to [kernel].

noun.title: Noun
noun.description: How the packages' descriptions and the changelog name the effect in prose ("8-band EQ", "channel strip"). Defaults to the short name.

version.title: Version
version.description: The release the plugin ships in: the Makefile's VERSION.

description.title: Description
description.description: One plain sentence a host shows: what the effect does for you.

features.title: CLAP features
features.description: The CLAP feature strings: audio-effect and stereo for every effect, plus the kind (delay, distortion, equalizer, ...).

class.title: LV2 class
class.description: The LV2 plugin class: lv2:DelayPlugin, lv2:ModulatorPlugin, lv2:Plugin, ...

params.title: Parameters
params.description: The parameters, in order. Append-only once released: the order is the CLAP param id and the LV2 port order.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: The parameter's field name: its LV2 symbol and its CLAP identity.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: The omx-contract export that holds the travel: a name in the kernel's file (or in primitives.json/rates.json). The numbers are read from it, never typed here.

kernel.title: Kernel
kernel.description: For a composite (several kernels): which of the plugin's kernels the reference is read from.

field.title: Field
field.description: For a reference whose travels are per field (GATE_LIMITS and the like): which field.

forKind.title: For kind
forKind.description: For a travel whose default differs per strip kind: the kind whose default a plugin takes (input, for an insert).

defaultRef.title: Default reference
defaultRef.description: For a reference to a list of values: the scalar export naming the value a fresh plugin comes up at.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: How a host should draw the travel.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The MOD GUI and house-view panel: a family, each control's role, and the sections drawn. Leave it out for a plugin with no panel yet.
